Redlands_draft_ES2026-2031.title: Redlands Coast Intelligence
Redlands_draft_ES2026-2031.description: An independent Redlands Coast dashboard with dated population, economy, household-cost, island, project and council-budget information. It links directly to council minutes, agendas, budgets, financial reports, live meetings and recordings.

ready-set-co-op-trust-hub.description: A public concept for Ready Sustainable Employment and Training Cooperative (Ready SET Co-op) covering co-working, shared equipment, training, local media and trust-building. Its 9 Ballow Road proposal at Dunwich / Gumpi concerns a building Luke identifies as still vacant. The Trust Hub has not been established.

aura-civic-establishment.description: A developing civic-use offering for 433 Logan Road, Stones Corner, Brisbane, responding to the QPS vacant-premises lease controversy. Its purpose is to support public safety and crime prevention through learning, mentoring, culture, enterprise, practical help and community participation. Adjacent project: the proposed Ready Sustainable Employment and Training Cooperative (Ready SET Co-op) Trust Hub at the still-vacant 9 Ballow Road building on Minjerribah. Other potential Redlands sites remain unspecified.
